book.name: Emwa Abefezi
book.title: AMARUBA EMWA ABEFEZI1, 0 Abanya-Efezi; Bantu b'Efezi, Abahubukaga e Efezi

content: Bâna, mukaz’iyumva ababusi binyu muli Nyakasane: okwo kushingânîne.
Okaz’ikenga sho na nyoko, -ly’irhegeko lirhanzi lirimwo eciragâne-,
ly’obona iragi onalame myâka minji en’igulu.
Ninyu, mwe babusi, murhakâg’isholoshonza abâna binyu, ci omu kubalera, mubayigîrize munabahanûle muli Nyakasane.
Bashizi, mukaz’iyumva ba nnâhamwinyu b’en’igulu, mubarhînye munabakenge n’omurhima gurhalimwo bulyâlya, nka kulya mwa­nkajirira Kristu.
Murhakâg’ikakolera isù nk’abalonz’isimîsa abantu, ci nka barhumisi ba Kristu bajira obulonza bwa Nnâmahanga n’omurhima gwoshi.
N’omurhima gwinyu gwoshi murhumikire Nyakasane, ci arhali abantu.
Murhahabiri oku ngasi muntu, akabà mushizi, akabà ntagengwa, ayishihâbwa na Nyakasane oluhembo lw’aminjà ajizire.
Ninyu, mwe bashigwa, mukabajirira nk’okwo. Muleke okukâbayôbohya, murhanayibagiraga oku Nnawâbo na Nnawinyu omu mpingu abà, n’oku arhajira kanânà.
Emirasano y’omukristu
Cabuzinda-zinda, musimike muli Nyakasane n’omu buhashe bw’emisî yâge.
Muyambale emirasano ya Nyamuzinda, lyo muhash’ihima obwengehusi bwa shetani.
Bulya ababisha rhulwîsa gurhali mubiri na mukò, ci Mâmi, n’Amahashe, n’Amarhegesi g’eri igulu ly’omwizimya; rhulwîsa abazimu babî babêra omu cirêre
Kuziga muyambale emirasano ya Nyamuzinda, ly’omu mango mabî muhashihagalika omushombanyi, muhimane, munayôrhe muzibuhire.
Muyimangire kuli gombi! Okuli bubè gwo mukaba gwinyu, obushinganyanya ebè yo mpenzi yinyu,
n’obushibirizi bw’okulumîza Emyanzi y’Akalembe zibè zo nkwêrho zinyu.
Muyôrhe mufumbasire empenzi y’o­buyêmêre, yo mwakahazamwo emyampi-kamole y’omubî
yoshi.
Muyambale n’ensirha y’obucire n’engôrho ya Mûka gwa Nnâmahanga, lwo Luderho lwa Nnâma­hanga.
Muyôrhe muharâmya n’okushenga ngasi mango muli Mûka Mutagatîfu; mukâyîza burharhama, munasengerere abatagatîfu boshi.
Munsengere nâni, lyo mbona oku nabumbûla akanwa, nderhe nampanûle n’oburhwâli ihwe ly’Emyanzi y’Akalembe;
yo ndi mujà-bugo wayo muno nkoba. Mâshi mbone oburhwâli bw’okuyiderha nk’oku ekwânîne!
Emyanzi ya Paolo n’omusingo
Nnonzize nti ninyu mumanye emyanzi yâni n’oku nyôsire; mwene wîrhu muzigirwa Tikiko, muganda okwânîne okucîkubagirwa muli Nyakasane, â­mmubwîra byoshi.
Mmurhumireye nti ammuhè emyanzi yîrhu anammurhûlirize emirhima.
Nyamuzinda Îshe na Nyakasane Yezu Kristu bashobôze bene wîrhu omurhûla, obuzigire n’obuyêmêre.
Enshôkano ya Nnâmahanga ebè haguma na balya boshi bazigira Nnawîrhu Yezu Kristu omu kalamo karhaheka!
